== Course of events ==

After Glinda the Good confronts Old Mombi and forces her, through the truth-detecting pearl, to abandon her lies, Old Mombi admits what became of the infant Ozma. She confesses that the Wizard of Oz gave her the baby Ozma, and that in exchange for the child she agreed to teach the Wizard magic tricks. Tip is present as Old Mombi makes this admission before Glinda the Good.

The confession lays bare the bargain struck between Old Mombi and the Wizard of Oz years earlier, explaining how the infant Ozma came into Old Mombi's keeping in the first place. Having admitted the exchange, Old Mombi is left with no further lie to hide behind, and the way is cleared for her to proceed to the transformation that follows, in which Tip's true identity as Ozma is revealed.
